t: You're on Chancery Lane, a one-way street forming part of the western edge of the City of London. The east side is within the City, while the west side belongs to Westminster south of Carey Street and Camden to the north. The route began as a new lane created by the Knights Templar, to reach land they had acquired south of Fleet Street, sometime before 1161. Among those who lived here was Caroline Lysaght Yonge, a British artist, who lived from 1884 to 1969.
